build.dependency_note: Standard library only. Runs on the authorized Windows workstation with nothing but Python installed.

audit_exit_code_ruling: Exit 2 is the correct and intended result on this host. A Linux lane cannot see C:\DataBoss, so every Windows-local item is UNREACHABLE and V12 is not called verified. The tower refuses to report a clean result it did not earn.
properties_enforced_and_tested: only the canonical 01_QUEUED folder is polled; the folder ID is pinned, not name-matched
filename text never grants authority; authority is folder membership by pinned ID
writes outside approved folders fail closed
mutation denied without an activated mutation TaskEnvelope
the exactly-once key binds command ID, Drive ID, and Drive revision
an unresolved claim prevents a second claim
monotonic fencing enforced; a zombie with an unexpired lease but a superseded token is refused
the spool is append-only and collision-safe via exclusive create
a Drive outage drops nothing and overwrites nothing; spool precedes the network call
secret values are redacted while keys remain readable
protected workbooks and source evidence cannot be uploaded, by digest, suffix, mime type, and ZIP signature
the HOLD cannot be removed or altered by any code path
canonical Drive URLs are rebuilt from verified IDs; metadata viewUrl is never reused
no non-Google URL is followed or trusted; docichat.com and livepolls.app are explicitly denied
